film: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery (1997)

dish.n: Dr. Evil's one million dollar steak Diane

steps.text: Bake the fries at 220C until crisp.
Bat out the steaks to about 1cm thick, season and sear in a very hot oiled pan, then rest on a plate.
In the same pan melt the butter and fry the mushrooms and shallot.
Add the brandy and let it bubble off, then add the Worcestershire, mustard and cream and simmer.
Pour the sauce over the steaks and serve with the fries and watercress.

film: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery (1997)

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice the jam rollette and line a large glass bowl. Drizzle with the sherry.
Scatter over the raspberries and pour over the custard.
Chill until the custard firms up.
Whip the cream with the icing sugar to soft peaks and spread over the top.
Lay strawberries in a cross and diagonals, then fill the gaps with blueberries to make a Union Jack.

film: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery (1997)

steps.text: Chill the martini glasses in the freezer.
Fill a jug with ice, add the gin and vermouth and stir steadily until very cold.
Strain into the glasses. Twist a strip of lemon zest over each, or add an olive on a pick.
Chop the eschalots and garlic.
Soften in some butter in a big pot.
Add the mussels and wine, cover and steam until open.
Toss through chopped parsley and a knob of butter.
Serve with crusty bread to mop up.

dish.n: Angel of Verdun chicken, cider and cream

steps.text: Season the chicken.
Brown in butter, 4 minutes a side, then set aside.
Soften the eschalots and mushrooms in the pan.
Pour in the cider and scrape up the browned bits.
Return the chicken, cover and simmer.
Stir in the cream and simmer until glossy.
Scatter with parsley and serve with a warm baguette.

dish.n: Gunfire: army tea with dark rum

steps.text: Warm a big teapot with boiling water and tip it out.
Add the tea bags and freshly boiled water and leave to stew until properly strong.
Put sugar and rum into each of four metal mugs.
Pour in the tea, add a splash of milk and stir well.
Cut the potatoes into thick chips and parboil, then drain and steam dry
Whisk the flour with the cold lager and salt
Dip the chips in the batter
Fry in batches at 180C until golden
Drain and toss with chicken salt
Mix the mayonnaise with garlic and lemon juice for dipping
Brown the chops in oil and set aside
Soften the onion and apples with sage
Pour in the cider, return the chops and simmer until the sauce reduces
Boil the potatoes and mash with butter
Chill four pint glasses in the freezer
Add cordial to each glass
Pour in the cider down the side, then top slowly with lager so it layers and foams
Serve straight away

dish.make_ahead: Up to 5 days in a tin

steps.text: Melt the butter with the sugar, paprika and bourbon.
Toss with the peanuts and pecans on a tray.
Roast at 160C, stirring once.
Cool on the tray.
Chill the sarsaparilla.
Put a big scoop of ice cream into each of four tall glasses.
Pour the sarsaparilla slowly down the side so it foams up over the ice cream.
Add a dash of bitters to each. For the cowboys, add bourbon before pouring. Serve with long spoons and straws.
Cut the potatoes into chips, toss in oil and roast until crisp.
Sear the steaks in a very hot pan, add butter and baste for a minute, then rest.
Add the red wine and stock to the pan and reduce until glossy.
Slice the steak and serve by candlelight.
Chill 4 martini glasses in the freezer.
For each drink, measure 60ml cold brew coffee, 40ml vodka, 20ml coffee liqueur and 10ml sugar syrup into a shaker.
Shake each drink very hard with plenty of ice for 15 seconds so it foams, then strain into the glass.
Float three coffee beans on top of each. Make it in batches of one or two.

dish.make_ahead: Make the sauce while the steak rests; fry the chips twice

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin frites and fry at 140C for 5 minutes, then rest.
Season the steaks and sear hard for 3 minutes a side, then rest.
Sweat the shallots in the pan fat, add the wine and reduce by two thirds, then whisk in the butter.
Fry the frites again at 185C until crisp.
Slice the steak and spoon the sauce over.

ingredients.item: celery salt and pepper, to taste

steps.text: Put a share of vodka, tomato juice, lemon, Worcestershire, hot sauce, celery salt and pepper in a tin with ice.
Pour back and forth between two tins 5 times.
Strain over fresh ice and add a celery stick. Repeat for each drink.

dish.n: Christmas plum pudding with brandy custard

steps.text: Steam the pudding in its basin over simmering water, or follow the packet.
Warm the milk and cream until steaming.
Whisk the yolks with the sugar and cornflour, pour in the hot milk while whisking, then return to the pan.
Stir over low heat until it thickens, then stir in the brandy and vanilla.
Turn out the pudding and pour over the custard.

dish.n: Connecticut inn hot buttered rum cider

steps.text: Simmer the apple juice with the cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and ginger without boiling.
Mash the butter with the sugar and nutmeg.
Strain the cider into mugs, add the rum and drop in a teaspoon of spiced butter to melt on top.

dish.make_ahead: Salt the steaks the night before

steps.text: Dry-brine the steaks overnight.
Cut the potatoes thin and fry at 140C, drain, then fry at 185C until crisp.
Sear the steaks hard in cast iron, pull at 54C and rest.
Crush the peppercorns in the pan, flame the brandy, add the cream and reduce until it coats a spoon.
Finish with the butter and serve.
Chill four coupes. Rub the rims with lemon and dip in sugar.
Shake the cognac, orange liqueur and fresh lemon juice hard with ice for 15 seconds, one drink at a time.
Strain into the coupes and twist orange peel over the top.

dish.n: Omi's pretzels with obatzda cheese dip

steps.text: Roll the dough into ropes and twist into pretzels.
Dip each in simmering water with the bicarb briefly.
Brush with egg, sprinkle with sea salt and bake at 220C.
Mash the camembert with the butter, cream cheese, lager, paprika, caraway and onion.
Serve the pretzels warm with the dip and cornichons.

ingredients.item: cloudy apple juice (half for the wine, half for anyone not drinking)

steps.text: Pour the wine and some apple juice into a saucepan with the sugar, half the spices and an orange.
Heat gently without letting it simmer.
Ladle into mugs with an orange slice each.
For anyone not drinking, warm the remaining apple juice with the remaining spices in a second pan.

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Cube the sponge and press into a glass bowl, then splash with sherry.
Make up the jelly and pour over the sponge.
Chill until set.
Spoon over the custard and top with whipped cream.
Chill overnight and top with raspberries.
Slice the orange.
Warm the wine with orange, cinnamon, cloves and honey gently without boiling.
Ladle into mugs.
Soften the diced onion in some of the butter.
Add the rice and toast, then add the wine.
Add the hot stock ladle by ladle, with the saffron steeped in, stirring.
Finish with the rest of the butter and the parmesan.
Fill four big wine glasses with ice.
Add the aperitivo, prosecco and a splash of soda water.
Add an orange slice.
Brown the beef in batches, then soften the onions
Stir in the flour first, then add the ale and stock, cover and braise at 160C
Cool slightly, tip into a pie dish and cover with puff pastry
Bake at 200C
Cut the potatoes into chips and fry them twice in the vegetable oil
Cook and crush the peas

dish.make_ahead: Chill the cans or bottles for at least 3 hours

steps.text: Chill the English ale and the lager in the fridge for at least 3 hours.
Pour the ale, or the lager for anyone who prefers it, into pint glasses at a tilt so the head settles, and raise them to the Winchester.

dish.make_ahead: Shallot butter up to 3 days

steps.text: Simmer the shallots with the wine until almost dry. Cool, then mix into the butter with the salt and chill.
Cut the potatoes into frites, rinse and dry thoroughly.
Fry in oil at 140C, then drain and cool.
Fry again at 185C until crisp. Salt lightly.
Season the steaks and sear hard in a hot pan with the oil to your preferred doneness.
Rest the steaks, then slice and top with the shallot red wine butter. Serve with frites.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.
Shake the gin, lemon juice and cooled syrup with ice.
Strain evenly into 4 chilled flutes and top each with champagne, pouring slowly.
Finish with a long strip of lemon peel.
Slowly cook the sliced onions in the butter for 20 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the brown sugar, the balsamic and the beer and simmer 5 minutes until jammy.
Grill the thick beef sausages on a medium barbecue for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Butter the slices of white bread, wrap each round a sausage and top with the onion relish, mustard and tomato sauce.
Cut the potatoes into chips and fry at 150C for 6 minutes, then 190C for 3 minutes.
Whisk the flour with the cold lager into a batter, dip the flathead fillets and fry at 180C for 4 minutes.
Mix the mayonnaise with chopped pickles for tartare and serve with lemon.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook 1 minute, then whisk in the ale.
Add the cheddar, mustard and Worcestershire and stir over low heat until thick and smooth.
Toast the sourdough.
Spread the cheese mixture thickly to the edges and grill until bubbling and browned in spots.
Cut in half and serve hot.
Pour the wine into a pot with sliced orange, cinnamon, cloves, star anise and honey.
Warm gently, never letting it boil.
Ladle into mugs by the fire.

dish.make_ahead: Dry-brine the day before

steps.text: Salt the steaks and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Sear hard in a hot pan.
Baste with part of the butter and thyme for a minute, then rest the steaks.
Add the wine and stock to the pan and reduce by half, then whisk in the rest of the butter.
Slice the steak and pour over the sauce.

dish.n: Red pill or blue pill gin fizz
dish.make_ahead: Two red and two blue, choose carefully

steps.text: For the red drinks, shake half the gin with half the lemon juice, the raspberry syrup and cranberry juice with ice and strain into two ice-filled glasses.
For the blue drinks, shake the rest of the gin and lemon juice with the blue curacao and sugar syrup and strain into two ice-filled glasses.
Top all four with soda water and add a lemon wheel.

dish.make_ahead: Slaw and salsa up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Whisk the flour with the lager into a batter. Mix the sour cream with lime juice.
Dice the tomato and onion and shred the cabbage.
Dip the fish in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes, in batches, until golden.
Warm the tortillas and fill with fish, cabbage, tomato, onion and the lime cream.

dish.make_ahead: Slush base freezes up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Stir the lemon juice, sugar syrup and water together and pour into a shallow tray.
Freeze for 3 hours, scraping with a fork every hour into a slush.
Put four glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes to frost.
Spoon the slush into the frosted glasses and top each with ice-cold lager.

dish.make_ahead: Dry-brine the steaks the night before

steps.text: The night before, salt the rib eyes and leave uncovered in the fridge to dry-brine. Bring to room temperature 30 minutes before cooking.
Sear the steaks hard in a very hot oiled pan on both sides.
Add the butter and rosemary and baste the steaks. Rest on a plate for 8 minutes.
In the same pan, crush in the peppercorns, add the brandy and flame it carefully.
Add the stock and cream and reduce until the sauce coats a spoon.
Pour the sauce over the rested steaks.
Stir the bourbon, sugar syrup and bitters over ice, in batches of one drink at a time, for about 30 seconds each.
Strain over one big ice cube in a short glass and twist a strip of orange peel over the top.

dish.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Soften the garlic and chilli in the oil. Add the tomatoes and vodka and simmer.
Stir in the cream until the sauce turns rosy. Meanwhile cook the penne in salted water until al dente.
Toss the pasta through the sauce and finish with parmesan and basil.

dish.n: Piña colada, with or without rum
dish.make_ahead: Blend fresh

ingredients.item: white rum, for the grown-ups (leave out for kids)

steps.text: Blend the pineapple juice, coconut cream and a big handful of ice until thick and smooth.
Pour into glasses for the kids. Add rum to the glasses for the grown-ups.
Brew the espresso and cool.
Shake the espresso, vodka, liqueur and syrup with ice very hard to build the foam.
Strain into chilled coupes and float coffee beans on top.

dish.make_ahead: Grown-up version adds liqueur

steps.text: Blend the ice cream with the milk until thick.
Pour into glasses. For the grown-ups, blend in the crème de menthe and crème de cacao.
Fill four glasses with ice.
Pour in coconut water and pineapple juice.
Add a splash of blue curacao for the adults.
Garnish with a pineapple wedge.
Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and 2 thin cucumber ribbons each.
Shake the gin, cordial and lemon juice with ice and strain evenly into the glasses.
Top with soda water, stir once and add a mint sprig. For non drinkers use chilled cucumber water instead of gin.
Blend the rum, pineapple juice, coconut cream, lime juice and ice until thick and smooth.
Pour into tall glasses.
Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cherry.
Stud the lemon wheels with the cloves.
Into four heatproof glasses put whisky, honey and lemon juice.
Top with just-boiled water and stir until the honey dissolves. Add a studded lemon wheel and a cinnamon stick to each.

dish.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week, keep chilled

steps.text: Simmer the cherries with the sugar and water, then mash well.
Strain and cool the syrup completely.
Fill tall glasses with crushed ice and add the cherry syrup, lime juice and bitters to each.
Top with soda water, stir once and garnish with a cherry and a lime wedge.

dish.make_ahead: Warm on the day

steps.text: Slice one orange and cut the other into four slices for serving.
Warm the wine with the sliced orange, spices and honey over low heat without letting it boil.
Strain into small heatproof glasses and add a fresh orange slice to each.
Salt the rims of four glasses.
Shake the tequila, orange liqueur and lime juice hard with ice.
Strain into the glasses.
Fill tall glasses with ice and pour the rye into each.
Add a squeeze of lime and a couple of dashes of bitters.
Top with ginger ale, stir once gently and garnish with a lime wedge.

dish.make_ahead: Base up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice the strawberries.
In a punch bowl, mix the cranberry juice, grapefruit juice and strawberries.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Add plenty of ice.
For the adults, top glasses with sparkling wine. For everyone else, top with lemonade.
Garnish each glass with a strawberry on the rim.

film: Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore (2022)

steps.text: Crush most of the raspberries, keeping four whole, with sugar and lemon juice, then push through a sieve.
Spoon puree into each of four flutes.
Slowly top with cold sparkling wine, letting the foam settle.
Drop a whole raspberry into each glass. For non-drinkers, use sparkling apple juice instead.
Peel the cucumber into long ribbons and curl one into each of four glasses.
Add cordial and a squeeze of lemon to each.
Top slowly with cold sparkling wine.
For drivers, use sparkling water and a little extra cordial.

film: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery (2022)

steps.text: Fill the tall glasses with ice, mint leaves and a squeeze of lime.
Pour the cold ginger kombucha into each and add the vodka to the glasses of anyone who wants it spiked.
Stir once and serve straight away.
Chill two big jugs in the freezer.
Stir the juice of three lemons with the sugar syrup and soda water.
Pour half the lager into each jug down the side, then top each with half the lemon soda.
Add lemon wheels and pour into chilled glasses.

dish.make_ahead: Assemble a day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Brown the mince.
Simmer with tomatoes and red wine.
Make a bechamel with butter, flour and milk.
Layer the meat sauce, bechamel, lasagne sheets and mozzarella.
Bake at 180C.
Rest before cutting.
Brew the espresso and let it cool slightly.
Shake the espresso, vodka and coffee liqueur very hard with ice until frothy, in batches.
Strain into chilled glasses.
Float three coffee beans on the foam of each.

dish.make_ahead: Syrup up to 2 days

steps.text: Simmer the honey, water and ginger, then strain and cool.
Shake the Scotch, lemon juice and the syrup with ice.
Strain into four tumblers over one large cube each.
Float a little peaty single malt on each and garnish with candied ginger.
Mix the salt and chilli powder on a plate.
Rub the rims of 4 pot glasses with lime and dip in the salt.
Add ice, lime juice, tomato juice, Worcestershire and hot sauce to each glass.
Top slowly with lager, stir once and add a lime wedge.

dish.n: Roger's ginger and lime lager shandy

steps.text: Fill tall glasses with ice and squeeze lime into each.
Pour in the lager, top with ginger beer and stir gently once.
Garnish with a lime wheel and mint and serve straight away.

dish.n: Jobu's dark rum and ginger punch

ingredients.item: dark rum, plus a small extra shot for Jobu

steps.text: Fill tall glasses with ice. Add the rum and lime juice to each glass.
Top with ginger beer and a couple of dashes of bitters. Stir once and garnish with a lime wedge.
Pour one extra small shot of rum into a glass and set it aside for Jobu before anyone drinks.

dish.make_ahead: Mix a jug without ice up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Juice the limes and cut a pineapple wedge for each glass.

Shake the coconut water, pineapple juice, lime juice and coconut cream with ice until frothy. Strain into 4 ice-filled glasses, add rum on the side if you like, and garnish with pineapple and a lime wheel.

dish.make_ahead: Make up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Slice the orange, lemon and apple into a big jug.
Add the wine, brandy, sugar and cinnamon stick and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Chill for an hour.
Fill four glasses with ice, pour in the sangria with some fruit and top with a splash of lemonade.

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the yolks with the sugar.
Heat the milk, cream, cinnamon and vanilla until steaming, then slowly whisk into the yolks.
Return to the pan and stir over low heat until it coats a spoon.
Strain and chill.
Stir in the rum and brandy, or serve them on the side. Pour into glasses and grate fresh nutmeg over the top.
Make the espresso and cool for 5 minutes.
For each drink, measure 1 shot espresso coffee, 40ml vodka, 20ml coffee liqueur and 5ml sugar syrup into a shaker.
Shake half the batch at a time with plenty of ice for 20 seconds until frothy.
Strain into chilled coupes and repeat. Float coffee beans on each.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003)

steps.text: Mix the lime juice, syrup, rum, pineapple juice and orange juice in a jug.
Pour over ice and grate nutmeg on top.
Shake each drink with milk, brandy, syrup, vanilla and ice for 15 seconds
Strain into small glasses over a large ice cube
Grate nutmeg over the top. Leave the brandy out for a plain vanilla milk

dish.n: Danko's cranberry mors and vodka cooler
dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Simmer the cranberries with the water and honey, crushing the berries.
Strain, add the juice of one lemon and chill the mors.
Fill tall glasses with ice. Add vodka and mors to each, top with soda water and stir.
Garnish with a few frozen cranberries and a lemon slice.

dish.make_ahead: Pate sets 4 hours, keeps 2 days chilled

steps.text: Sear the livers in some butter until pink inside
Flame with the brandy
Blitz with the soft butter and thyme
Set in a dish and chill
Slice and toast the baguette and spread with pate and a little fig jam
Stir the vodka, juices and lime juice together in a big punch bowl
Chill
Just before serving add the lemonade, ice and orange slices
Ladle into party cups. Swap the vodka for extra lemonade for anyone driving
Tilt each glass and pour the stout three-quarters full
Let it settle for a minute, then top up slowly for a tight head. Allow 2 cans per person

dish.make_ahead: Mix a jug ahead, strain over ice per glass

steps.text: Stir the bourbon, vermouth and bitters with ice in a jug.
Strain into chilled glasses.
Drop a cherry into each glass.
Stir the maple syrup with the juice of two lemons in a jug. Chill the beer glasses.
Pour a spoonful of the maple lemon mix into each glass and half fill with cold lager.
Top with lemonade, pouring slowly down the side to keep the head. Add a lemon wedge.

film: The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert (1994)

dish.make_ahead: Purée up to 1 day, top with sparkling just before serving

steps.text: Blend most of the raspberries with the peach and sugar syrup until smooth, then strain.
Spoon the purée into four chilled flutes.
Top slowly with cold sparkling rosé, stir once gently and drop in a raspberry. Use sparkling grape juice for an alcohol-free version.

dish.make_ahead: Mix and shake fresh

steps.text: Chill 4 coupe glasses in the freezer.
Pull the espresso and let it cool.
Shake the vodka, liqueur, espresso and syrup hard over ice so it foams, one drink at a time.
Strain into a chilled coupe and float 3 coffee beans on the crema.
Fill four large wine glasses with ice.
Pour limoncello into each, top with prosecco and soda and stir once gently.
Peel a wide strip of lemon zest per glass, twist over the drink and drop in. Finish with mint.

dish.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: For each drink, cut half a lime into wedges and muddle hard in a glass with the sugar.
Fill with crushed ice, add the cachaca and stir well.
Top with cold guarana soda and stir once more. For a booze-free version, skip the cachaca and fill up with more guarana.
For each drink, put the bourbon, the lemon juice, the sugar syrup and a little egg white in a shaker.
Shake without ice for 10 seconds to build the foam, then add ice and shake hard for 10 seconds more.
Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass.
Add a few drops of aromatic bitters on the foam and a cherry.
For non-drinkers, swap the bourbon for cold black tea.
Freeze four martini glasses.
Working in two batches, stir the gin and vermouth with ice.
Strain equally into the frozen glasses.
Express the lemon twist oils over each drink and garnish.

dish.n: Tech Noir dark rum Cuba libre

steps.text: Cut the limes into quarters.
Fill four highball glasses with ice and squeeze two lime quarters into each, dropping the shells in.
Add the rum and a dash of bitters to each glass, top with cold cola and stir once.
Juice the limes and rim four glasses with a lime wedge and salt.
Shake the tequila, orange liqueur and lime juice with ice in batches, one drink at a time.
Strain into the glasses over fresh ice.

ingredients.item: mint leaves, plus sprigs to serve

steps.text: For each drink muddle lemon wedges with sugar syrup and mint in a shaker.
Add bourbon and ice, shake hard and pour everything into a tumbler.
Top with crushed ice and add a big sprig of mint.
Squeeze the oranges and strain the juice into a jug.
Chill the juice.
Pour juice into chilled flutes, tilting the glass, then top slowly with sparkling wine.
Garnish with a thin twist of orange peel.

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the yolks with the sugar.
Heat the milk, cream and cinnamon stick until steaming, whisk into the yolks and return to the pan.
Stir over low heat until it coats a spoon.
Chill.
Serve with grated nutmeg and brandy on the side.
Warm the milk with the honey, cinnamon and vanilla until steaming without boiling
Rest and remove the cinnamon
Whisk hard until frothy
Pour into mugs, add brandy to each and grate over a little nutmeg. Leave out the brandy for the warm milk crowd
